info.title: Moses Fullstack OIDC App API
info.description: OIDC relying-party app (BFF pattern) built on the vendored oidcauth middleware. Add one entry under `paths` for every route you register (paths are relative to the servers[] /api/v1 prefix) — the Moses platform reads this spec to generate workspace tools.

get.description: Protected route (OIDC plumbing — keep it). Returns the principal resolved by the OIDCAuth middleware — either from a validated session cookie or from trusted X-Moses-* pod-to-pod headers. Includes the roles projected from resource_access.<client>.roles; role-based authorization decisions are made server-side by the handlers that need them.

401.description: Not authenticated (no session, no trusted headers)

roles.description: resource_access.<client>.roles projected by Moses onto the ID token.
